title: Auditing a Moving Target: Evidence Anchoring and the Expiry of Fairness Audits of Provider-Served Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Organizations increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for decisions about people, such as hiring, investment and employee evaluation, and rely on them over long periods of time. Fairness audits of such systems, however, are conducted only once. We examine how the biases of LLMs change over time. In a venture screening setting, models from five providers decided whether and how much to invest in startups whose founders differed only in gender, origin and university. We repeated this audit three times over 13 months (248,400 API calls). Study 1 shows that the same model, called under the same identifier one year later, displayed a significantly different bias pattern. Study 2 shows that the successors of retired models carried the same bias as their predecessors, but in a significantly different size and form. translated_title: 审计一个移动的目标：证据锚定与供应商服务语言模型公平性审计的失效
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20901v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：组织越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行涉及人员的决策，例如招聘、投资和员工评估，并在长时间内持续依赖这些模型。然而，对此类系统的公平性审计通常只进行一次。我们研究了LLM的偏见如何随时间变化。在一个创业项目筛选的场景中，来自五个提供商的模型决定是否投资以及投资多少给那些创始人仅在性别、籍贯和就读大学上有所不同的初创公司。我们在13个月内重复进行了三次审计（共248,400次API调用）。研究1表明，一年后在相同标识符下调用的同一模型表现出显著不同的偏见模式。研究2表明，已退役模型的后继模型继承了与前代相同的偏见，但其规模和形式却显著不同。研究3表明，这种偏见并不取决于初创公司所处的行业。进一步的文档分析显示，提供商……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对五个提供商的语言模型在13个月内进行三次重复公平性审计（24万余次API调用），发现同一模型及后继版本的偏见会随时间显著改变，因此一次性公平性审计会很快失效。
en_tdlr: Through three repeated fairness audits of language models from five providers over 13 months (over 240,000 API calls), this study shows that biases of the same model and its successors change significantly over time, meaning one-time fairness audits quickly expire.
